hero.headline: Car Hire & Private Driver in Addis Ababa
hero.subheadline: Request a vehicle and private driver for airport pickup, city travel, day trips, or multi-day itineraries. We provide quotes after reviewing your request.

options.name: Sedan
options.description: Comfortable for 1–3 passengers. Ideal for city transfers and short trips.

options.name: SUV
options.description: Spacious for 1–5 passengers. Perfect for day trips and rougher roads.

options.name: Minivan
options.description: Group travel for 6–12 passengers. Best for families and small groups.

form.headline: Request a Car Hire Quote
form.subheadline: Tell us about your trip and we'll provide a detailed quote within 24 hours.
form.disclosure: Vehicle type, availability, driver details, and final price are confirmed after your request is reviewed.

faqs.question: Do you offer self-drive car hire?
faqs.answer: No. All our car hire includes a professional local driver who knows Addis Ababa's roads and traffic.

faqs.question: What's included in the price?
faqs.answer: The quote includes vehicle, driver, fuel, and insurance. Parking fees and tolls are additional.

faqs.question: Can I hire a car for multiple days?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multi-day car hire is available for city travel, day trips, and multi-day itineraries.

faqs.question: What if my plans change after booking?
faqs.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. We can adjust the vehicle or schedule based on your updated plans.
